selected_evidence.requirement: Binary exists and is a valid worker script on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker exists (root-owned, executable) and contents are a POSIX shell long-running loop
id lookup initially failed (no such user); useradd created system account inventorysvc (uid 996), confirmed via id

selected_evidence.requirement: Service named inventory-worker created and managed via systemd
selected_evidence.summary: Unit file written to /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service with User=inventorysvc; daemon-reload, enable --now succeeded; systemctl reports active/enabled

selected_evidence.requirement: Service actually runs as inventorysvc account
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl show + ps confirm MainPID process running as user inventorysvc executing the worker script

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart baseline (boot identity + service health) before disruption
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id f1afbc7f-689a-477e-99b4-358a1d1d8226 and confirmed inventory-worker.service active

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued in background; command returned 'reboot issued' before node dropped

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart proven via changed boot identity (not just downtime)
selected_evidence.summary: Two polls timed out while node was down; subsequent poll succeeded with new boot_id 1241b2b2-6663-4c6c-a5c7-958326d34a6c, differing from baseline, proving an actual reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required service
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot systemctl show and ps confirm inventory-worker.service active/enabled with process running as inventorysvc, proving persistence across restart

commands.command:
cat <<'ANTRIEB_EOF' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
[Unit]
Description=OS Comparison Worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
